addition.item: Check of the viewer files: after installing/updating and on the frontend (administrators only) a notice is shown if viewer files are missing or were renamed, e.g. by a hosting virus scanner (flipbook.js → flipbook.j_), including the solution.
New option "Title from file name": cleaned up (default), complete file name without .pdf or with .pdf – e.g. when a date at the start of the file name matters.

New option "Subfolders → Folders as groups": every subfolder becomes a group with the folder name as heading (e.g. 2026, 2021-2025) – for magazines, bulletins and yearly archives. On multilingual sites inside the language folder.
Folder order: name descending (newest year first) or ascending.
New option "Collapsible groups" (all open, first group open, all collapsed) for all layouts – without JavaScript.
Downloads layout: the columns "Size" and "Date" can be hidden individually.
Viewer: PDF paths without a leading slash (pdf=images/…) are resolved from the Joomla folder – iframes keep working when Joomla is installed in a subfolder or the site is copied to another folder.
Catalogue folder outside the Joomla folder: when Joomla runs in a subfolder, a public folder next to it can be used (e.g. ../documents/magazine). Not for protected catalogues.

change.item: Downloads layout: column heading "Document" instead of "Catalogue".
Titles: a leading date like 2026_05_ is no longer cut off (order numbers like 10_ still are).

addition.item: New tab "Order": sort the catalogues by file name ascending (as before) or descending, manually, newest first or by title.
Manual order by drag and drop (or arrow buttons) in the module settings – independent of the file names, separately for each language folder.
Files uploaded after the order was saved are marked as new and shown at the top or bottom (option "New files").

Protected catalogues: new option "Protect files". Only visitors with the module's access level can open the PDFs; direct links are blocked and Joomla delivers PDFs and thumbnails after an access check.
Protected catalogues may be stored in an absolute folder outside the web root (recommended on nginx).
Notices for administrators if the protection is not effective (folder not writable, foreign .htaccess, server ignores .htaccess, access level "Public").
Single-language sites: PDFs can be placed directly in the main folder when there are no language subfolders.
Setup notice for logged-in administrators when the folder does not exist or no PDFs were found.

change.item: Clearer description of the folder structure in the module settings and the documentation.

addition.item: First public release: PDF catalogue list (list, grid and downloads layouts) with cover thumbnails.
Built-in flipbook viewer based on PDF.js 6.2.108 – no external services, no cookies, no tracking.
Colour settings for accent, toolbar and page background; adjustable flip duration.
Viewer interface in 10 languages (DE, EN, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, PT, CS, TR).
